title: 2023 Panini Score George Kittle Celebration San Francisco 49ers #17 Football
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2023 Panini Score trading card featuring NFL player George Kittle from the San Francisco 49ers. The card is part of the Celebration insert set and is made of 20 Pt. card stock. It is an original licensed reprint with English language text. The card does not include an autograph and is manufactured by Panini in the United States. The card number is 17 and it is part of the 2023 football season collection.
